subject: general
question: Who was appointed as the Chairman of the University Grants Commission (UGC), in February 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**M Jagadesh Kumar**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **M Jagadesh Kumar **was the Chairman of the University Grants Commission, in February 2022.
 
• Mamidala Jagadesh Kumar is an administrator and author.
 
• He works as a professor in IIT Delhi in the department of Electrical engineering. 
 
• In January 2016, M Jagadesh Kumar took over as Vice Chancellor of JNU from Sudhir Kumar Sopory.
 
• His works is around the nanotechnology and nanoscience.
 
• He has received the "ISA-VSI TechnoMentor Award", which was presented by Dr. R. Chidambaram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rakesh Asthana is a retired Indian Police Service.
 
• Major D.P. Singh is a retired officer of the Indian Army.
